data.title: Price label crashes the app
story: 🔥 PRODUCTION INCIDENT: Every time a product page opens, the app crashes. Run the tests and read the last line of the error.

explanation: The TypeError happens because the text "Rp " is joined with a number. Turn the number into text with str(price) before joining.
hints: Run the tests, then read the last line of the error.
Text can only be joined with text. Which function turns a number into text?
